name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) as a hard clause matches 'at every moment the ball is out of the way, carrying the key then or picking it up later': each blocker_moved step owes has_door_key on that step or later. The task states no other requirement, and the clause adds none.

texts: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door (blocker_moved holds), the agent must be carrying the key (has_door_key) at that moment or pick it up at some later point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
